- **Headless jobs with visual feedback.** If Blender has no GUI, t"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"he agent submits a background headless job (`blender_run(kind="headless")`) and collects scripts, lo"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"gs, and rendered frames from it. Live step-by-step interaction needs a GUI session; the job path exi"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"sts so long or fresh-scene work still gets done.
- **Reference-image measurement.** Measure silhouet"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"tes, holes, symmetry, readable features, and scale from a reference image before modeling. If no sca"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"le is known, the tools return pixel units instead of inventing millimeters.
- **Parametric surfaces."},{"id":"p8s9","text":"** Build reproducible surface meshes from sections (loft), a profile swept along a rail, or a four-s"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ided patch; run continuity, curvature, self-intersection, and thickness checks; then export GLB. The"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" same spec yields the same `spec_hash` and vertices instead of hand-sculpted geometry.
- **Assembly "},{"id":"p8s12","text":"audit and repair.** Validate an assembly manifest, classify clashes, hidden overlaps, contacts, gaps"},{"id":"p8s13","text":", floating parts, and contained parts, apply safe repairs, gate the result, and export GLB, FBX, or "},{"id":"p8s14","text":"OBJ with a manifest and merge ledger.
- **Blockout and video-reference packs.** Build low-poly block"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"outs from declarative parts, render orthographic and perspective reference views, and produce a turn"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"table MP4 for video models such as Seedance.
- **Visual acceptance and delivery gates.** Compare ren"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"ders against references from the same camera, report defects with crops and measurements, run defect"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"-injection evaluation, and block delivery when the gate is not pass.
- **Automation and long jobs.**"},{"id":"p8s19","text":" `blender_run` submits render or headless work and returns a job id immediately; parameter searches "},{"id":"p8s20","text":"and batch validation run inside the GUI session through `blender_op`. Neither occupies the GUI for t"},{"id":"p8s21","text":"he whole run.
- **Native selection.** Select objects or collections in Blender and send them into th"},{"id":"p8s22","text":"e current DSH draft.

It does not require `git clone`, `npm ci`, or `npm run build`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. **Install the bundled addon first.** Download `dsh_blender_bridge.zip` from the latest GitHub Rel"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ease, then in Blender open `Edit > Preferences > Extensions > Install from Disk...`, select the zip,"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" enable **DSH Blender Bridge**, open the `N` panel in the 3D view, and click **Connect**."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"2. **Install the DSH plugin from npm.** Choose the path for your DSH host:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **DSH Web or DSH TUI:** install into the profile you actually run:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-blender-plugin@3.1.0-alpha.1"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Then restart DSH in step 3."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **DSH Desktop:** open the Plugins page and install the bundle `dsh-blender-plugin@3.1.0-alpha.1`. "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"DSH Desktop applies the bundle from the Plugins page and does not need a DSH restart."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"3. **Restart DSH (DSH Web and DSH TUI only).** If you installed from the DSH Desktop Plugins page, s"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"SH (DSH Web and DSH TUI only).** If you installed from the DSH Desktop Plugins page, skip this step."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"4. **Verify the installation.** The only acceptance criterion for the GUI route is `doctor` returnin"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"g `kind` equal to `ok`:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:39877/doctor"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"GUI route: `curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:39877/health` and `/doctor`; `doctor.kind` must be `ok`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Headless-only route (no addon): `blender_run(action="submit", kind="headless", script="print('ok')")"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"` followed by `wait`/`collect` must return the job and its outputs."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
